title: for drives the cursor in available, item, body, successor order
purpose: Observe type, generic and collection semantics.

stdout.text:
available 2
item 2
body 2
successor 2
available 1
item 1
body 1
successor 1
available 0

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 9.9: for obtains one cursor, checks available() before each item, binds one item, then calls the successor; false available() ends iteration without item/successor.

notes: Role and action names follow the active std (Iterating/item/successor); see D-036.
